output.reason: The 1.16 upgrade notes say `ces-write-qps-limit` is one of the flags that "have been deprecated and their usage will be ignored" [ev-7994b2163342]. The same note says the operator now uses dynamic rate limiting based on cluster size. A configured value that stops being honoured is setting-ignored, so this is action work, and the proposed statement matches the evidence. The evidence does not say how severe the effect is. The way to restore a custom setting is the `ces-rate-limits` flag or the Helm value `ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits` [ev-7994b2163342].
